_readme: THRESHOLDS FOR `node tools/perf-audit.mjs --budget`. Exceeding one fails CI.
==> THESE ARE PLACEHOLDERS UNTIL THE FIRST GREEN RUN ON THE RUNNER. <==
They were written from measurements taken through a Chrome extension on a
Mac, and two things make those unsafe to freeze as a budget: a Mac is the
FASTEST platform in SPEC-NEXT §52 (204ms first paint against Windows' 684),
and the tab was backgrounded for part of the session, which stops the map
building at all. So each number below is set loose enough that only a real
regression trips it. CALIBRATE THEM from the first workflow run's JSON and
tighten in a reviewed commit — a budget nobody can pass gets switched off,
and a budget nothing can fail is decoration.
`armUnderBudget` is `warm-sw` deliberately: 1,991 of 2,036 D1 sessions are
service-worker controlled, so that is the path worth defending.
